Name: A Greener Standard Farm Map
Author: cherrycolouredfunk
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4]
[/size][/font]Since this is my first mod making this was kind of messy and this may still have some bugs. [font=Tahoma]I may no longer be able to update this mod, so if you would like to make some changes that would be fine with me. 
[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]

[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]✧﻿[b] [/b][b]Features﻿ [/b]✧[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]﻿
﻿Tillable grass and less yellow dirt[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿Replaces standard map by default (configurable)[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿New ponds - LessPond by default (configurable)[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿Pet bowl - compatible with Starblue Valley and Eemie’s Map Recolors.

[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]﻿✧﻿ [b]Installation[/b] ✧[/size]

[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿. [/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size][/font][font=Tahoma]
[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿3. Download this mod and unzip it, then copy the ‘[CP] A Greener Standard Farm Map’ folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿4. Run the game once using SMAPI to generate the config file.[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿5. Access the config file and choose your settings. [/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]

[/size][/font][font=Tahoma]﻿[size=4]✧﻿[b] Config Options[/b] ✧[/size][/font][font=Tahoma]

[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3][b] ﻿> Option[/b] - choose between “[b]LessPond[/b]”(no pond in the lower-right corner) or “[b]AddPond[/b]”(has pond in the lower-right corner); defaults ﻿to LessPond. "[b]OriginalPonds[/b]" (just the 2 original ponds from the standard map).
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3][b] ﻿>﻿ MapToReplace[/b] - choose between “[b]Standard[/b]”, “[b]Foraging[/b]”, “[b]Fishing[/b]”, “[b]Mining[/b]”, “[b]Combat[/b]”, and “[b]FourCorners[/b]”; defaults to Standard.[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=5]﻿✧﻿✧﻿✧ [b]IMPORTANT![/b] ﻿✧﻿✧﻿✧[/size][/font][font=Tahoma]
[/font][font=Tahoma]
[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]Please read below if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]Eemie’s Map Recolor[/url]﻿.[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3][b]For Starblue Valley[/b]:[/size][/font][font=Tahoma]
[/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿> Open it’s config file and find:[/size][/font]
[font=Courier New][size=3]"GroundUnderBowl": “Default”, [/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]and set it to[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3] "GroundUnderBowl": "void”.[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3][b]For Eemie’s Map Recolor[/b]:[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3] ﻿> Open it’s config file and find:[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3]"Petbowl": “vanilla”, [/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]and set it to[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3] "Petbowl": "void”.
[/size][/font]
[font=Tahoma][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=2]This is my first custom map/mod. I tested it and everything seems to be working but if you notice some bugs please do tell me. :)[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=2]
[/size]
Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3573617]monteso[/url]﻿ for letting me use the leaves surrounding the farm from his mod ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/536]Monteso's Farm and Farm Cave Expansion[/url]﻿.
[/font][font=Tahoma]


[/font]
